events.description: Puzanov introduced USSR Academy of Sciences delegation led by Asimov to Taraki; discussed scientific cooperation and Soviet assistance.
April 27 Revolution (Saur Revolution) brought the PDPA to power; Taraki says it took 10 hours.
PDPA began heading the progressive forces, per Taraki.
Puzanov introduced a USSR Academy of Sciences delegation headed by Asimov to Taraki; discussed scientific cooperation and Soviet assistance.
April 27 Revolution: PDPA seized power in Afghanistan, in about 10 hours.
PDPA began heading progressive forces in Afghanistan (as described by Taraki).
Puzanov conversed with Prof. Dvoryankov during his Kabul visit about Soviet-Afghan cooperation.

key_claims: Taraki credited Soviet Union, CPSU and Soviet government with helping the April 1978 revolution develop.
Taraki said the DRA wanted to be a member of the socialist community.
Taraki claimed the PDPA had led progressive forces since 1965 and the revolution took 10 hours.
Soviet and Afghan sides planned scientific cooperation, including a new Academy of Sciences of Afghanistan.
